messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: proportion histogram
parts:
Hi All,

I'm wondering if there is a geom option that can make proportional
histogram, i.e the area of the histogram is scaled to 1. This might be
useful when histogram is qploted with facet_wrap or facet_grid when
different panel has very different number of counts. I do find
weighted histogram but it is not exactly what I am looking for.

--
Regards,
Peng

parts:
Hi,

'..density..' doesn't work in the following case. Could anybody let me
know what is wrong?

data=rbind(
data.frame(x=sample(LETTERS[1:4], 100, replace=T), y=1)
, data.frame(x=sample(LETTERS[1:4], 100, replace=T, prob=rep(1,4)/4), y=2)
)

qplot(x,y=..density.., data=data,geom='histogram')+facet_wrap(~ y)

qplot(x, data=subset(data, y==1),geom='histogram')
qplot(x, data=subset(data, y==2),geom='histogram')

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: proportion histogram
parts:
It's to do with grouping:

qplot(x,y=..density.., data=data,geom='histogram', group = 1)+facet_wrap(~ y)

By default each stat/geom operates on groups defined by the
combination of all categorical variables on the plot.

Hadley
